Dentro del perfil de ingreso del titulo, tambien entrarian titulados universitarios en otras areas de conocimiento afines'. Alternative routes: >=3 years full-time demonstrable professional experience in software design/development/project management/quality/web/infosec, or >=250 taught hours of specific training in software/web engineering or infosec. Oversubscription tie-break: expediente grade average, then matriculas de honor.
non_eu_admission_route: UNIR accepts non-EHEA degrees WITHOUT homologacion for official master's entry, subject to UNIR verifying equivalence: 'Ser titulado conforme a sistemas educativos ajenos al EEES sin necesidad de homologar sus titulos. UNIR comprobara que se acredita un nivel de formacion equivalente a los titulos universitarios oficiales espanoles y que facultan, en el pais expedidor, para el acceso a postgrados. Esta via no implicara, en ningun caso, la homologacion del titulo previo.' The international-access page (Anexo 3 del Reglamento de Acceso y Admision, Consejo Directivo 16/07/2016) covers document legalisation and links a per-country list for master's access; it also describes admision condicionada for cases that DO need homologacion. This is a genuinely favourable rule for a Tunisian applicant.
accepts_engineering_background: YES - EXPLICIT. The admission page names 'graduados en Ingenieria Informatica' as the primary intake profile. A Software Engineering degree is the target profile, not an exception.

credit_recognition_available: AVAILABLE. Per-title caps (Criterios de Reconocimiento del Titulo, approved 21/04/2021): ensenanzas superiores oficiales NO universitarias min 0 / max 0; titulos propios min 0 / max 9; acreditacion de experiencia laboral y profesional min 0 / max 9. Recognition of credits from a prior OFFICIAL university degree is governed by the general Normativa RTC (no numeric cap stated there for master level). UNIR-wide rules (Reconocimiento de creditos page + Normativa RTC): the prior study ('estudio de reconocimiento') is free and must be requested up to 10 days before matriculation; recognisable inputs are any official university study, expertos/cursos universitarios >110 h, CEFR B1+ language certificates, Ciclos Formativos de Grado Superior, and accredited professional experience. CRITICAL FOR COST: 'NOTA: Para los estudios de Master, los alumnos abonaran la matricula completa del Master y estaran eximidos de pagar por el Reconocimiento y Transferencia de los creditos' - i.e. at master level recognition does NOT reduce what you pay. No UNIR rule was found that gives advanced standing for a 300-ECTS / 5-year first degree specifically; the 300-ECTS surplus is not addressed anywhere on UNIR's published pages.
